basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled two-story single-family home in the desirable Ingleside Heights neighborhood! The main level offers a spacious living room, a dedicated dining area, a modern remodeled kitchen, a stylishly remodeled bathroom with a walk-in shower, and two comfortable bedrooms. The lower level provides exceptional flexibility with two bonus rooms that can serve as additional bedrooms, home offices, or creative spaces, along with a full bathroom featuring a tub/shower with elegant tile surrounds. A laundry room adds convenience, while the attached one-car garage offers both parking and a generous storage room. Located near Stonestown Galleria, SF State, and top-rated schools, this home also provides easy access to public transportation and Highway 280 for a seamless commute.
